lookupStatus.description: Whether the user list was resolved.

id.description: Numeric X user id as a string.

handle.description: X screen name (handle) without the leading @.

displayName.description: Display name shown on the profile.

avatarUrl.description: Best available square avatar image URL.

bannerUrl.description: Profile banner image URL when available.

location.description: Location string from the profile when provided.

website.description: Primary outbound link (expanded URL) from the profile.

verified.description: Whether X marks the profile with legacy verification (not necessarily paid blue).

isBlueVerified.description: Whether the account has X blue (paid) verification.

followerCount.description: Follower count from X when available.

followingCount.description: Following (friends) count from X when available.

tweetCount.description: Total post (status) count from X when available.

listedCount.description: Listed count when X provides it.

profileUrl.description: Canonical public profile URL on x.com (`https://x.com/<handle>`).

profileImageShape.description: Avatar crop shape reported by X, such as Circle or Square.

verifiedType.description: X verification type label when provided (for example a government or organization note).

pinnedTweetIds.description: Pinned tweet ids from X, in display order.

type.description: Professional account type from X, when present.

id.description: X's numeric id for the category.

name.description: Category name shown on the profile, such as `Science & Technology`.

icon_name.description: X's icon name for the category, such as `IconBriefcaseStroke`.

items.description: A professional category X shows on the profile.

category.description: Professional categories X shows on the profile.

restId.description: Professional account rest id from X, when present.

professional.description: X professional-account metadata when the account is marked professional.

withheldInCountries.description: Country codes where the profile is withheld.

favoritesCount.description: Total likes (favorites) on the profile when available.

mediaCount.description: Media item count when X provides it.

description.description: Affiliate or business label text shown on the profile.

badgeUrl.description: Badge image URL when X provides one.

url.description: Destination URL for the label link.

type.description: X label type, such as `BusinessLabel` for an affiliation or `AutomatedLabel` for a bot account.

longDescription.description: Longer label text when X provides one, such as `Automated by @owner`.

affiliateLabel.description: Affiliation or automated-account label shown next to the name, when X provides one.

items.description: Compact X user card for list endpoints.

users.description: Users returned for this page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor to pass in the next request when more pages exist; null on the last page.

page.description: Cursor pagination for this user list.

requestId.description: Unique request identifier for tracing this API call.

version.description: Public API version that served the response.

meta.description: Metadata describing the request and billing outcome.
